# Intake, exhaust, tune and forced induction

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Replace the stock Y-pipe with a Dynomax VT muffler. [t26]

Install an UpRev tuner software for advanced diagnostics at a cost of $500. [t26]

Install a Dynomax Cat Back Stainless Kit with Super Turbo muffler and Walker Mega-Clamps. [t43]

[Partial] Install the Walker Quiet Flow muffler into an existing Dynomax cat-back system. [t43]

[Partial] Mount snorkel tube to vehicle's A-pillar and secure assembly using nut inserts. [t926]

[Partial] Check local rules, gather connectors, install coils, connect plugs, merge wires, route remaining wires, then plug in. [t280]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Check local rules and regulations regarding emissions before starting.
2. Gather an Audi/VW style female connector.
3. [Partial] Obtain a Nissan style male connector with wire attached.
4. Acquire two pin-style connectors, one straight from China if preferred.
5. [Partial] Install the new Audi R8 coils into the engine bay.
6. [Partial] Connect NGK spark plugs to complete the ignition setup.
7. Merge wires 2 and 4 from the Audi plug onto the middle wire of the Nissan connector.
8. Route the remaining two wires directly across their respective positions.
9. Plug in the connectors to finalize the installation.

_Procedure reported by [t280]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-audi-r8-coilpack-conversion.9654/>_

## Tips & gotchas

- The spacer acts as a heatsink to lower intake air temperatures. [t26]
- Longer bolts are required due to the added height of the spacer. [t26]
- The Dynomax muffler can be installed 'backwards' to eliminate the need for a Y-pipe. [t26]
- The Walker Quiet Flow features a 20-inch body length. [t43]
- It has a 2-1/2 inch ID inlet and outlet with an offset inlet and centered outlet. [t43]
- [Partial] Use a sealant to prevent leaks at the A-pillar connection. [t926]
- [Partial] Consider mandrel-bent tubing for smoother airflow if standard bends are too tight. [t926]
